documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Setco Automotive reported a year-on-year revenue growth of 7.8% for Q1 FY26, reaching Rs. 178.8 crore compared to Rs. 165.8 crore in Q1 FY25, driven by robust product demand. EBITDA for the quarter rose by 11.9% to Rs. 21.6 crore.

guidance.claim: The MHCV industry is expected to grow at an exponential double-digit rate exceeding 30%.
guidance.quote: MHCV industry is expecting to grow at exponential double digit growth rate of >30%

guidance.claim: Setco sales to OEMs are estimated to exceed the industry average due to BSVI channel and pipeline inventory restocking.
guidance.quote:
Setco sales to OEM’s estimated will be higher than the industry average due to
 BSVI Channel and pipeline inventory restocking/build-back

guidance.claim: Revenue per unit of approximately 25% will remain going forward.
guidance.quote: Revenue per unit of ~25% will remain going forward

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue growth in Q1 FY26 was mainly on account of continued and robust demand for Setco's products.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue from Operations stood at Rs. 178.8 crore in Q1 FY26, as against Rs. 165.8 crore in Q1 FY25, a growth of 7.8% on a year on year basis, mainly on account of continued and robust demand for Setco’s products

demand_outlook.claim: As the economy unlocks, fleet utilization will progressively improve, leading to higher demand for clutches in the aftermarket.
demand_outlook.quote: As economy gets unlocked, fleet utilization will progressively improve and long delayed repairs/over-hauling will be needed, resulting in higher demand for clutches in the aftermarket in coming years.

demand_outlook.claim: The market is now coming back strongly following the subdued Q1FY22 caused by the second Covid wave.
demand_outlook.quote: While Q1FY22 has been subdued due to Covid wave-2, market is now coming back to strongly

demand_outlook.claim: Long-overdue replacement of the past has started coming and is expected to continue for the foreseeable future.
demand_outlook.quote: Long overdue replacement of the past has started coming and expect to continue for the foreseeable future

demand_outlook.claim: OEM production schedules of Q4FY21 exceed Q4FY20 and are expected to continue in coming years.
demand_outlook.quote: OEM production schedules of Q4FY21 exceeds Q4FY20. As per available data it is expected to continue in coming years

demand_outlook.claim: Strong schedule for Q4FY21 and going forward is noted in the farm sector.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong schedule for Q4FY21 and going forward

capex_expansion.claim: Planned maintenance capex for Lava Cast is getting completed by H1FY22.
capex_expansion.quote: Due to liquidity issues, planned maintenance capex is getting completed by H1FY22 and would result in higher capacity utilization

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY26 EBITDA grew 11.9% year-on-year primarily due to higher sales, favourable segment mix, and higher operational efficiencies at Lava Cast and foreign subsidiaries.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the Q1 FY26 is Rs. 21.6 crore as against Rs. 19.3 crore in Q1 FY25, a year on year growth of 11.9%, mainly on account of higher sales, favourable segment mix and higher operational efficiencies at LAVA cast and Foreign subsidiaries

margins_costs.claim: Profitability is expected to improve in coming years driven by stable raw material pricing, superior segment mix, and proactive cost management.
margins_costs.quote: We expect that driven by stable RM pricing, superior segment mix and pro-active cost management to improve profitability in the coming years

margins_costs.claim: Fixed cost reductions and savings of over 24% have been achieved over the last two years.
margins_costs.quote: Already achieved Fixed cost reduction /savings of over ~24% in last two years

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins improved from 5% in Q3FY20 to 12.5% in Q3FY21 due to a substantial reduction in fixed costs down by about 18%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins improved from 5%in Q3FY20 to 12.5% in Q3FY21 up by 750bps (~INR 850 lakhs improvement), due to substantial reduction in fixed cost (down by ~18%)

margins_costs.claim: Contribution margin in Q3FY21 was at 28.2%, up by 50bps against 27.7%.
margins_costs.quote: Contribution margin in Q3FY21 at28.2%up by 50bps as against 27.7%

margins_costs.claim: The company is on track to bring down fixed costs by over 20% or approximately INR 18 crores over FY19.
margins_costs.quote: On track to bring down the fixed cost by ~>20% (~INR 18crs) over FY19

orders_capacity.claim: Setco commands over ~65% market share in the MHCV segment.
orders_capacity.quote: Commanding over ~65% market share in the MHCV segment, a testament to our product excellence.

orders_capacity.claim: Setco retains its market leadership with over 85% market share in the MHCV OEM segment.
orders_capacity.quote: Setco continues to retain its market leadership with >85% market share in MHCV OEM segment.

orders_capacity.claim: The aftermarket segment experienced an unexecuted strong order book representing approximately 6-8 months of sales.
orders_capacity.quote: Unexecuted strong order book approx. 6-8 months of sales

orders_capacity.claim: The maximum capacity utilization achieved by Lava Cast is only about 52%.
orders_capacity.quote: Teething problems: LowerCapacity utilization (max achieved is only ~52%) and high rejection rates (~17% - 19%).

orders_capacity.claim: The company continues to retain market leadership with over 85% market share in the MHCV OEM segment.
orders_capacity.quote: Setco continues to retain its market leadership with >85% market share in MHCV OEM segment

orders_capacity.claim: Aftermarket revenue grew by about 12% in Q3FY21 and the Q4FY21 order book is stated to be the best ever.
orders_capacity.quote: Revenue grew by ~12% in Q3FY21. Strong order book, Q4FY21 demand/order book is the best ever

orders_capacity.claim: Lava Cast capacity utilization stood at 28% in Q3FY21.

capital_allocation.claim: The investment proposal with India Resurgence Fund involves moving down the clutch business into Setco Auto Systems Pvt. Ltd through a slump-sale process.
capital_allocation.quote: The Investment Proposal involves moving down the clutch business of the company into the subsidiary Setco Auto Systems Pvt. Ltd through BTA (slump-sale) process

capital_allocation.claim: Investment from the India Resurgence Fund will consist of a combination of non-convertible debentures, compulsory convertible debentures, and equity.
capital_allocation.quote: Investment will be in the combination of Debentures (NCDs), CCDs and Equity

capital_allocation.claim: The debt restructuring proposal for Lava Cast has been approved and implemented by the banks.
capital_allocation.quote: Restructuring proposal of bank has been approved and implemented

risks_headwinds.claim: FY21 EBITDA margins suffered a large downfall due to lower operating leverage and a quarter lag in recovering raw material pricing.
risks_headwinds.quote: EBITDA margins has shown a large downfall at 2.9% in FY21 due to lower operating leverages and quarter lag on recovering RM pricing

risks_headwinds.claim: Lava Cast experienced high rejection rates ranging between 17% and 19%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Teething problems: LowerCapacity utilization (max achieved is only ~52%) and high rejection rates (~17% - 19%).

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain constraints affected production during Q3FY21.
risks_headwinds.quote: Q3FY21 would have been much better, but supply chain constraint has affected the production

risks_headwinds.claim: Frequent lockdowns in foreign countries resulted in lower sales and impacted profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Frequent lockdown in foreign countries has resulted in lower sales and impacted profitability

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to complete all formalities regarding the India Resurgence Fund deal within the next 7-15 days.
management_commitments.quote: Expect to complete all formalities in next 7-15 days.

management_commitments.claim: Farm tractor clutch business started with two OEMs and expects to add another 2-3 in the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Business started with two OEM’s viz Sonalika and Preet Tractors, expect to add another 2-3 in this financial year

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to start farm equipment sales with a few other OEMs in the next 3-4 months.
management_commitments.quote: Farm equipment : Sales started with 2 OEM’s, expects to start with few others in next 3-4 months

management_commitments.claim: Efforts toward rationalizing fixed costs will continue in coming years, which will add to the bottom line.
management_commitments.quote: Our effortsrationalizingfixed cost will continuein coming years,whichwill addtothebottomline.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
